annotations.title: Get VET qualification Units and packaging rules

description: Read a VET qualification by exact code (for example BSB50420). Returns the official packaging rules, and a page of core and elective entries in source order. Entries retain group labels and a Unit may occur in more than one group. Pass a release to read historical rules. Preserve contentVersion and release for subsequent pages. The linked website generates Course Outlines. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

contentVersion.description: Reuse the contentVersion from page 1 for later pages.
